newsitem.title: UK: Playtex awards $15 mln ad account to DDB Needham.
newsitem.headline: Playtex awards $15 mln ad account to DDB Needham.

text.p: Playtex Apparel Inc on Tuesday said it awarded its U.S. advertising account to DDB Needham Chicago.
The ad account is worth about $15 million, a DDB Needham spokeswoman told Reuters.
DDB Needham, part of Omnicom Group Inc, announced the account award in Europe.

"Playtex was looking for a strategic partner to help make the Playtex brand and its leadership category advertising spending more attractive and relevant to women," Hayward Gipson, Playtex chief executive officer, said in a statement.
DDB Needham said its first assignment will be to create a new campaign to be launched in the autumn for Playtex's largest brand, Eighteen Hour.
Playtex, whose other brand names include Cross Your Heart, Playtex Secrets and Body Language, is a division of Sara Lee Corp.
